```{r}
#| warning: false
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
exp1 = read.csv("Experiment1_FullData.csv") %>% mutate(Model = ifelse(Model == "Model C+ (Enhanced)", "StatPrompt-LLM", Model))
exp2 = read.csv("Experiment2_FewShot.csv") %>% mutate(Model = ifelse(Model == "Model C+ (Enhanced)", "StatPrompt-LLM", Model))
exp3 = read.csv("Experiment3_Ablations.csv") %>% mutate(Model = ifelse(Model == "Model C+ (Enhanced)", "StatPrompt-LLM", Model))
exp4 = read.csv("Experiment4_Efficiency.csv") %>% mutate(Model = ifelse(Model == "Model C+ (Enhanced)", "StatPrompt-LLM", Model))
```

# Experiment 1 - Full Data

**Note**: For both Mean Squared Error (MSE) and Mean Absolute Error (MAE), **lower** values are better, as they indicate smaller prediction errors.

```{r}
exp1 %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = c("DLinear", "PatchTST", "Autoformer/FEDformer", "Model C (Original)", "StatPrompt-LLM"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(MSE, MAE), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Score") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Model, y = Score, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ Dataset) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "MSE and MAE by Model (Full Data)", y = "Error Score", x = NULL)
```

```{r}
exp1 %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = c("DLinear", "PatchTST", "Autoformer/FEDformer", "Model C (Original)", "StatPrompt-LLM"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Train_Time, Inf_Time), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Score") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Model, y = Score, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ Dataset) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Training and Inference Time by Model (Full Data)", y = "Time (seconds)", x = NULL)
```

# Experiment 4 - Efficiency

```{r}
library(patchwork)

df4 <- exp4 %>%
  mutate(Model = if_else(Model == "Model C (Original)", "Time-LLM", Model)) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, levels = c("DLinear", "PatchTST", "Autoformer/FEDformer", "Time-LLM", "StatPrompt-LLM"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Train_Time, Inf_Time), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Score") %>%
  mutate(Metric = factor(if_else(Metric == "Train_Time", "Training Time", "Inference Time"), levels = c("Training Time", "Inference Time")))

model_colors <- c("DLinear" = "#0072B2", "PatchTST" = "#E69F00", "Autoformer/FEDformer" = "#009E73", "Time-LLM" = "#CC79A7", "StatPrompt-LLM" = "#56B4E9")

p1 <- df4 %>%
  filter(Metric == "Training Time" & Model %in% c("Time-LLM", "StatPrompt-LLM")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Model, y = Score, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = model_colors) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "serif", base_size = 14) +
  theme(text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black", size = 13),
        legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Training Time", y = "Time (Seconds)", x = NULL)

p2 <- df4 %>%
  filter(Metric == "Inference Time") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Model, y = Score, fill = Model)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = model_colors) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "serif", base_size = 14) +
  theme(text = element_text(color = "black"),
        axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, color = "black", size = 13),
        legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Inference Time", y = NULL, x = NULL)

p1 + p2 + 
  plot_layout(widths = c(3.5, 6.5)) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Training and Inference Time by Model (Efficiency)",
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(family = "serif", color = "black", size = 16)))

ggsave("Experiment4_Efficiency.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
```
